description: Your own control room for your servers, Macs and PCs: live readings, alerts, automations, files, terminals and history on your own hardware, reached from anywhere at your-name.bananana.dev and in the bananana.dev iPhone and Android apps through an outbound end-to-end encrypted relay (no open ports or VPN). Website: https://bananana.dev

env.description: From https://bananana.dev/start (starts with bst_). Only used on the first start.
env.label: BANANANA_SETUP_TOKEN
env.name: BANANANA_SETUP_TOKEN

name: bananana-brain
note: First create a free account at bananana.dev/start and copy the setup token it shows (it starts with bst_) into Setup token; it's only used on the first start and is the only setting you need. Then open your brain at the address bananana.dev gives you, or on your network at https://this-host:18771 (port 18771, HTTPS with a self-signed certificate, same sign-in). Its data lives in /portainer/Files/AppData/Config/bananana-brain: keep it backed up. Help: bananana.dev/help/docker
title: bananana brain
